reviews.title: Shady Business Practices
reviews.text:
The app itself is pretty solid. The issue is - there’s no reasonable way to cancel a subscription. 

I’ve attempted to cancel a subscription from the App Store only to get charged three days after I’ve cancelled. Then, go to the app - there’s no way to cancel a subscription on there. 

In fact, when you go to the customer support section, there’s a whole page called Cancel Subscription. But rather than allowing you to cancel your subscription, it forces you to fill out a customer support ticket. 

Thus, considering that cancelling from the App Store isn’t respected and that the app itself provides no way to cancel a sub (not to mention a $7/WEEK subscription) - I can only conclude that this app is essentially malware. I will be reporting these charges as fraudulent to my bank tomorrow.
